import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')

from shop.pagination import paginate
from shop.models import Product
from shop.database import db
import sqlalchemy as sa

# Create in-memory database
engine = sa.create_engine('sqlite:///:memory:')
db.metadata.create_all(engine)
Session = sa.orm.sessionmaker(bind=engine)
session = Session()

# Create 5 products for simplicity
for i in range(1, 6):
    product = Product(name=f"Product {i}", price=i * 10.0)
    session.add(product)
session.commit()

query = session.query(Product)
print(f"Initial query: {query}")

# Call paginate
result = paginate(query, page=1, per_page=2)
print(f"\nResult from paginate: {result}")
print(f"Result[0] type: {type(result[0])}")
print(f"Result[0]: {result[0]}")

# What test does
items = tuple(query.offset(0).limit(2).all())
print(f"\nTest's items: {items}")
print(f"Test's items type: {type(items)}")

# Check if they're the same objects
print(f"\nresult[0][0] is items[0]: {result[0][0] is items[0] if len(result[0]) > 0 and len(items) > 0 else 'N/A'}")
print(f"result[0][0] == items[0]: {result[0][0] == items[0] if len(result[0]) > 0 and len(items) > 0 else 'N/A'}")
print(f"id(result[0][0]): {id(result[0][0]) if len(result[0]) > 0 else 'N/A'}")
print(f"id(items[0]): {id(items[0]) if len(items) > 0 else 'N/A'}")

# Check all products in session
print(f"\nAll Product instances in session:")
for obj in session:
    if isinstance(obj, Product):
        print(f"  {obj} id={id(obj)}")

# Check query state
print(f"\nQuery after paginate: {query}")
print(f"Query offset: {query._offset}" if hasattr(query, '_offset') else "No _offset attribute")
print(f"Query limit: {query._limit}" if hasattr(query, '_limit') else "No _limit attribute")
